text: Okay... I guess I don't really have a good answer for that. Honestly, I'd rather not provide the address right now if there's another way. It's just... I don't know, it makes me nervous. Maybe I'll just have to contact you again later when I feel more comfortable with it? I can't really force myself to give it out right now. I'm just sad about the whole situation, and it's making everything harder.
zh: 好的……我想我并没有一个很好的答案。老实说，如果还有其他办法，我宁愿现在不提供地址。就是……我不知道，这让我感到紧张。也许我只好稍后再联系你们，等我更舒服了再说？我现在真的无法强迫自己提供它。我对整个情况感到难过，这让一切变得更难。
